date_note: Date of the deportation flight as stated in the Manila Times (Tuesday, 24 November); the raid was on 3 November, older than the map window.
title: Philippines deports 139 Indonesians after Pasay scam hub raid
geo_basis: raid location (KE Tower, Cuneta Avenue, Pasay City) per the article
summary: The Manila Times reports the Bureau of Immigration deported 139 Indonesians on 24 November after a raid on a suspected scam hub in Pasay City on 3 November. Authorities rescued and profiled 166 foreigners, the article says. Investigators allegedly found a parcel scam in which workers posed as police officers to pressure victims into handing over money.
plain: The Philippines sent home 139 Indonesians after police raided a suspected scam centre in Pasay City, where investigators say workers posed as police to get money from victims.
exec: A cross-border scam operation targeting victims in several countries was raided and its Indonesian workers deported, according to the Manila Times.

evidence.quote: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) deported 139 Indonesians following a major crackdown
Authorities rescued and profiled 166 foreigners at the facility, including 138 Indonesians,

validation.note: Manila Times only (read). The article attributes its facts to the Bureau of Immigration and unnamed investigators; no BI release was read. Article gives 138 Indonesians among 166 rescued but 139 deported, unexplained.
